summary: The US Treasury's decision to double its long-end bond buybacks — from $2 billion to at least $4 billion per operation effective September 9 — has driven a synchronized dollar sell-off, gold surge, and crypto rally, pulling sentiment sharply higher across gold and crypto while stocks remain flat.
tweet: A weak dollar, strong gold, and surging Bitcoin are three reactions to the same trigger — Treasury's buyback doubling — with Warsh's Jackson Hole debut on Friday the next event to clear.
